what: No official or contemporaneous record has been found for 1951 or 1967: UF’s digitised Gazette has no issues for those years, and The Grenada Newsletter began in 1973. These years come only from ElectionPassport, and every figure is marked ✱. 1976 is now covered by the Newsletter and the Gazette’s 1976 electors notice (see E-18).
action: Ask the Grenada National Archives or the Government Printery for the Gazette results notices of October 1951 and August–September 1967.
sources: UF Digital Collections, Grenada Government Gazette (UF00076858)
